product: The Snowflake AI Data Cloud: consumption-priced data platform plus AI layer (Cortex AI, Cortex AI Gateway) and agentic apps CoCo (9,100 accounts) and CoWork (5,800) per SEC 8-K EX-99.1 dated 2026-09-02. Customers 1Password, Indeed and Sayari adopted; Sayari cut costs over half migrating 12B records (2026-09-02).
demand: Volume and mix, not price. On 2026-09-02 Snowflake reported 692 net new customers (+32% YoY) and 828 customers over 1M usd TTM product revenue (+27%), NRR 126%. Consumption pricing means revenue tracks usage volume; AI workloads (CoCo, CoWork, Cortex) are the mix shift lifting product revenue to +37% in Q2 FY27.
pricing_power: AI inference/compute cost scaling faster than consumption revenue; heavy stock-based compensation drives the 17.0% GAAP operating loss versus 15.3% non-GAAP operating margin (2026-09-02). Cheaper open models and customer cost pressure (Sayari) could compress pricing. GAAP product gross margin 70.9% versus 74.7% non-GAAP (2026-09-02, SEC 8-K EX-99.1).
competition: Yes. Snowflake itself added Chinese open models DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731 and GLM-5.3 to Cortex AI (2026-08-18), commoditizing frontier inference. Rival low-cost platforms (Databricks, BigQuery) substitute for the warehouse layer, and cheap open models substitute for expensive frontier APIs, but not yet for Snowflake's governed data platform.
market_strategy: CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy, 2026-09-02: AI compounds our advantages; the Agentic Enterprise runs on Snowflake. CFO Brian Robins, 2026-09-02: raising full-year product revenue growth guidance to 36% YoY; Q3 FY27 product revenue 1,588-1,593M usd (+37-38%), non-GAAP operating margin 15.5%. Source SEC 8-K EX-99.1.
bull: Q2 FY27 (2026-09-02, SEC 8-K): product revenue +37% YoY, third straight acceleration, FY27 guide raised to 6.07B (+36%) with non-GAAP margin up; 47 raises/33 firms in 90d.
bear: GAAP operating loss 263.0M (-17.0%) vs 237.0M non-GAAP; GAAP gross margin 70.9% vs 74.7% non-GAAP; open models commoditize inference; §17 target levels carry no signal.
falsifier: Q3 FY27 results (late Nov-early Dec 2026): product revenue below 1,588M usd, or FY27 guidance cut below 36% growth, or NRR at/below 120% (was 126%).
